scripts.spackled: git ls-files | xargs git check-attr spackled | grep -v 'unspecified$' | cut -d: -f1
scripts.prespackle: npm run --silent spackled | xargs rm || true
scripts.postspackle: git ls-files | xargs git check-attr spackled | grep -v 'unspecified$' | cut -d: -f1 | xargs git add
